text:
sam-devex: Morning all — coordination thread for tomorrow's Py/TS SDK publish. Plan: canary to test registries with explicit tag `canary-interop`, then RC, then GA. Any blockers?
mia-ux: Can we avoid npm tag collisions? Last time `canary` got reused and caused confusion.
alex-release: Agree on `canary-interop`. Also add changelog note about deprecating `syncClient` with migration steps.
priya-eng: Packaging plan: Python prerelease with `rc0` -> `rc1` on TestPyPI; for npm publish under `canary-interop` then add `rc` dist-tag for RC. We'll keep artifacts for 48h on test index.
sam-devex: Deploy bot examples for publishing commands:
```
# npm
npm publish --tag canary-interop
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.4.0-canary-interop canary-interop

# python
python -m build
twine upload --repository testpypi dist/*
```
deploy-bot: [publish-trigger] started pipeline redwood/sdk-release-2147001234 branch release/1.4.x
deploy-bot: built artifacts: @redwood/sdk@1.4.0-canary-interop, redwood-sdk-1.4.0rc0.tar.gz
mia-ux: Can the bot attach checksums and wheel links?
priya-eng: Yes. Infra: keep TestPyPI artifacts 48h and expose artifact links.
alex-release: Rollback criteria: canary telemetry >1% 5xx on token endpoints OR failing CI on staging. Rollback steps:
1) npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary-interop
2) npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.3.5 canary-interop
3) For Py: avoid reusing versions; on public PyPI we won't delete GA; for test releases we'll remove if possible and document yanked status.
sam-devex: DevEx Oncall will watch 06:00-09:00 PST. If >0.5% error uplift, call it out.
priya-eng: Reminder: don't reuse Py versions on PyPI. Use rc suffixes for prereleases.
alex-release: Release notes draft:
- streaming improvements and batching heuristics
- deprecated `syncClient` in favor of `asyncClient` (link to migration guide)
- new canary/rc tagging to reduce publish collisions
mia-ux: Can someone add migration snippet in docs?
sam-devex: I'll add it. Deprecation cadence: 2-week console banner + doc banner, then 30-day removal plan unless customers request extensions.
priya-eng: Npm org automation will add `deprecated` notice on old package names when we flip the deprecation.
sam-devex: Rollout timeline:
- 06:00 PST: publish canary -> monitor 1h
- 07:15 PST: if clear, tag RC and publish rc
- 08:30 PST: staging smoke + SDK integration tests
- 09:00 PST: if green, publish GA

deploy-bot: [publish-trigger] succeeded: artifacts uploaded https://ci.internal/build/2147001234/artifacts
priya-eng: Pushing release notes and changelog update to PR now.
alex-release: Preparing release PR with versions and cherry-picks.
mia-ux: :thumbsup:
devex-oncall: Monitoring window set. I'll post updates 07:30 and 09:05 PST. If we yank please record which step was executed.
sam-devex: Thanks all. Keep this thread for rollback/hotfix decisions.
